name: Lessons in the Mire

start.dialog: I'm trying to teach the Mire children - the ones who live in the stilt-houses. But I need supplies. Books, writing materials, anything educational. Can you help gather them?
start.objective: Collect educational supplies for the Mire children

progress.dialog: The children are eager to learn. Even in this place, education matters. Every bit helps.
progress.objective: Continue gathering books and writing materials

complete.dialog: Thank you! The children will be so happy! Here - this bow was a gift from my sister. I want you to have it. For protecting the future.

party_comments.kade: Teaching kids. Even here. That's important.
party_comments.vex: Educating the young. The best way to change the future.

hidden_outcome: If you bring rare 'Advanced Mathematics' and 'History of the World' books, Serah gives you 'Starseeker' - her ultimate bow
